title: What a Change of Date Costs on a Snowsports School Booking
content:
The fee for a change of date on a Snowsports School booking is the product's move fee, and the figure is rounded to the nearest cent.

The share of the booking's value that is added to it is taken on the tuition standing alone, and where the booking earns no share nothing is added on that count.

A move does not reprice the booking, so the tuition already standing on it is untouched by the change.

## The amounts that enter the fee

The notice fee is the product's move fee. The handling amount for re-arranging what the school laid on stands at 0.00 USD. The rebooking amount for freeing an instructor stands at 0.00 USD. The share of the booking's value stands at 0 percentage points.

The notice fee, the handling amount and the rebooking amount are added together; the share of the booking's value is worked out on the tuition standing and added to that total; and the fee charged is the whole rounded once to the nearest cent.

## The fee on a hypothetical booking

Take a booking of the Semi-Private Coaching Session, whose move fee is 45.00 USD, on which tuition of 549.00 USD stands.

The notice fee is 45.00 USD. The handling amount adds 0.00 USD and the rebooking amount adds 0.00 USD, so the three together come to 45.00 USD. The share of the booking's value, at 0 percentage points of the 549.00 USD tuition standing, adds nothing. The fee charged for the change of date is therefore 45.00 USD, and the 549.00 USD of tuition standing on the booking is left as it was.

## Notes on the charge

- The fee is charged for the change of date itself; the tuition already raised on the booking is neither raised again nor given back because the date moved.
- Rounding is done once, on the whole figure, to the nearest cent.

The move fees this reckoning reads are published product by product on the Snowsports School tariff.
